name: 19123 · Philadelphia, PA
findings: ZIP 19123 (Philadelphia) has 174 nonprofit organizations. 92 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 81 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19123 (Philadelphia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19123 (Philadelphia) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 81 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
